--ground: The page's ground; a field's ground; a running span's open bar.
--raised: A card's, a row's, a button's and a file's ground; the label's ground.
--wash: A table's head, a code span, a disabled button, the shown view of a switch, a timeline's track.
--hover: A button under the pointer; the switch's ground.
--line: A card's, a row's, a file's and a table cell's edge; the chart's top and foot; a disabled button's edge; a quote's rule.
--edge: A button's and a field's outline.
--ink: The words; a field with words in it; a bar or a span under the pointer or the keyboard.
--quiet: Quiet words: a card's time, a figure's name, a heading, the empty line, a file's time, the chart's scale and names, the hours; a bar at rest; a placeholder.
--act: What a person acts on: a link, the focus ring, the primary button, a checkbox's colour.
--act-ink: The words on the primary button.
--act-hover: The primary button under the pointer.
--bad: A failed span on the timeline.
--live-edge: The outline of a span that still runs.
--float-hover: A button under the pointer under the dark theme.
--size-caption: The smallest size: a card's time, a figure's name, a heading, the chart's and the timeline's words.
--size-small: A page's words, a card's body, a button, a table, a file, the label.
--size-body: A card's title, a row's name, a field.
--size-lead: A second-level heading in a card's words.
--size-title: A count's figure; a first-level heading in a card's words.
--leading-body: Line height at the body size.
--leading-small: Line height at the small and caption sizes.
--leading-glyph: Line height of the chart's scale.
--weight-strong: The strong weight: headings, a title, a figure, the shown view.
--space-8: 32px: the least height of a press under a coarse pointer.
--radius-small: A code span's, a bar's and a span's corners.
--radius: A card's, a button's, a field's and a file's corners.
